title: GLM-5.3 NVFP4 on eight Sparks
evidence_scope: GLM-5.3 (744B, GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM) at tensor-parallel size 8 with decode-context parallelism 4, a 1,048,576-token context window, 43 GiB of fp8_ds_mla KV cache per Spark and no speculative decoding. Runs only on SIRCL ring sessions with NCCL off, on all eight Sparks of an eight-Spark ring; no image lock in this package lists it, so it installs only with a development image lock (v3) whose image carries the SIRCL layer and lists the profile. No installation of this profile has run on hardware. A launcher outside this repository served this checkpoint at TP8 with decode-context parallelism 4 on SIRCL with NCCL off on one eight-Spark ring (one light run, 2026-10-07; no record of that run is in performance/records); this profile's model settings are pinned only where its guide says. Not serving-qualified.
